sections.heading: Overview

sections.content:
North Coast Local Land Services (NCLLS) is establishing a Pest Animal Contractors Panel to provide a reliable and qualified pool of service providers to deliver pest animal management programs across the North Coast region. The panel will support the delivery of strategic pest animal control activities on public and private land, contributing to improved biosecurity, agricultural productivity, environmental protection and community outcomes.
Services may include the planning and implementation of pest animal control programs, monitoring and reporting, landholder engagement, and the use of approved control techniques in accordance with relevant legislation, policies and best practice guidelines.
The panel arrangement will enable NCLLS to engage suitably qualified contractors in a timely and cost-effective manner to respond to emerging pest animal issues and deliver targeted management programs. Contractors will be required to demonstrate appropriate experience, qualifications, licences and a commitment to safe and environmentally responsible work practices.
The expected outcomes of the project are improved coordination and efficiency in pest animal management, reduced impacts of pest species on agriculture and natural assets, enhanced capacity to deliver regional pest management priorities, and strengthened partnerships with landholders and stakeholders across the North Coast region.
